item.title: Korn's Inequality
item.description: Korn’s inequality asserts the control of the $L^2$ norm of the gradient of a vector field by the $L^2$ norm of its symmetric part, under certain conditions.

item.title: Use Linux in Windows: Subsystem
item.description: A major update in Windows 11 is to provide WSL2 as a more efficient and elegant solution for running Linux on Windows. By utilizing a lightweight utility virtual machine and a real Linux kernel, WSL2 bridges the gap between Windows productivity and Linux development power, providing nearly 100% system call compatibility. This note records how I set up my personal development environment in WSL2.
